config.q1: unchanged direct baseline answer; no Q1 inference in any policy
config.existing_policies: baseline, previous_agent and candidate are exactly the PR56/57 gold policies (configs/q1_fixed_q2_cues_q3_legacy_gold_v1.json); saved gold steps are reused when prompt and image bytes match
config.matched_reask_q2: direct Q2 answer, then one own-answer re-check without definitions (2 calls, same as previous_agent direct + define)

config.q3_evaluation: image-label presence only; spatial accuracy null
config.selection: analysis-only control added after gold; no setting is chosen or changed from gold scores
config.gold_limit: existing gold246 has prior exploratory use; not a new untouched holdout
config.failure_gate: all planned policies and dependencies must have full coverage, zero errors and zero invalids
